Not a field on VBAK. The link back to the originating quotation is modeled as a Sales Document Flow record (VBFA) connecting the quotation document to this order, not a foreign key on the order itself -- same 'relationship, not a field' pattern as Manager_ID in the Employees example.

Preserving the human-readable legacy number ('SO-2025-00001') as the actual VBELN requires external number range assignment for the sales document type in the target system; otherwise SAP assigns its own number and Order_Number survives only as a cross-reference attribute.
Reformat ISO date string to SAP DATS (YYYYMMDD).

Not free text on VBAK. SAP determines the ship-to party as a partner function on the order (VBPA, PARVW='WE') whose address resolves from that partner's master address (ADRC). If the legacy address differs from the customer's standard ship-to address, it becomes a one-time/manual address override linked via VBPA-ADRNR rather than plain text -- same decomposition challenge as Address in the Employees example, one level more complex.

Modeled as a partner function on the order (VBPA, PARVW='VE') referencing a Personnel Number, not a plain FK field. Resolve via the HR>Employees mapping (see employees_field_mapping.csv) to get the target PERNR.

sap_field: pricing subtotal via KONV condition records
transform_notes: Not a single header field. SAP's pricing procedure builds the order value step by step from condition records (KONV / S/4's PRCD_ELEMENTS); a 'subtotal before discount/tax' is one step's result, not a column. Loading this legacy value means creating/importing condition records that reproduce it, not writing to a field.

sap_field: KWERT (for a discount condition type -- e.g. header discount)
transform_notes: Header-level discount condition record in the pricing procedure -- same derived-from-conditions pattern as Subtotal.
Header tax total field; cross-check against the tax condition records in KONV for the document's pricing procedure.

sap_field_description: Net Value of the Sales Order
transform_notes: NETWR is SAP's net order value; if Total_Amount is meant as gross (incl. tax), that is NETWR + MWSBK rather than a single stored field -- confirm which the legacy Total_Amount represents before mapping.
Resolve via Foundation>Currencies lookup to a valid SAP currency key.
Lives on VBKD (Sales Document: Business Data), not VBAK itself. Resolve via Foundation>Payment Terms lookup, which maps to T052.

sap_field: GBSTK / LFSTK / FKSTK (Overall / Delivery / Billing Status)
transform_notes: SAP has no single 'Status' field. Overall processing, delivery, and billing status are tracked as separate indicators on VBUK (header) and VBUP (item), normally maintained automatically as the order flows through delivery and billing. A single legacy status value like 'Invoiced' or 'Shipped' must be translated into the combination of these indicators for historical/open orders being migrated mid-process -- flag for careful cutover review, this is not a simple value lookup.

Consistent with Foundation>Approval Requests: SAP order release/approval is rebuilt via credit management and/or a release strategy in the target system, not migrated as a data record. Only genuinely open/in-flight approvals may need manual re-creation.
